label: 9. Maybe it's because the year is coming to an end,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Maybe it's because the year is coming to an end,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: but I feel a little upset.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: And that's despite the fact that this was a very happy year for me!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: What about you, Old-Timer?
This year is a happy year for me as well.
I just want this year to be over.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Whoa, glad to hear that!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's wonderful!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I hope the upcoming year brings you

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: all sorts of bliss and happiness as well.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Why is that?
Because I've been swamped with work this entire year.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Well, I'm sure that next year will be easier for you.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Anyway, let's just hope that you can have as many happy moments as possible

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: in the days that remain for this year,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and in the next.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Oh, and one more thing, Old-Timer.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Thank you for

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: being there for me this year.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I hope that you can continue to be with me next year,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: the year after,

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: and the year after that!
I wish for the same.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: You do?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll always be with you, Old-Timer, I swear!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: You make me feel so loved!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I should go and tell Belorta that

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I hope I can continue keep her company all of next year as well.
Okay.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Catch you later!
